# Negative control for tests/test_public_claim_backing.py

Backing and breadth are both fine here: the sentence links a receipt that
resolves, and it claims no more breadth than that receipt covers.  What it
does not do is say that the receipt came out FAIL, so the citation reads
as support for a claim the measurement contradicts.

The t=0 comparison reproduces the reference state at the FP32/operator
floor across every carrier group the digest scored
([receipt](receipts/failed_state.json)).
